# PaintFE v1.4.16

- PaintFE now warns before saving editable layers, text or masks to an image format that cannot preserve them. Choose a PaintFE project, continue saving the image, or cancel.
- Saving before closing now waits for completion. Failed saves keep the document open, and exporting an image keeps the open layers intact.
- PFE projects now preserve layer masks and whether they are enabled. Masked projects require this version or newer to reopen. Existing projects remain supported.

Normal single-layer image saves and existing PFE saves continue to save directly when no information would be lost.

Related to issue 205, which remains open for confirmation.
